all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَزُخۡرُفࣰ اۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ

translations.saheeh: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.
translations.pickthall: And ornaments of gold. Yet all that would have been but a provision of the life of the world. And the Hereafter with your Lord would have been for those who keep from evil.
translations.khattab: and ornaments ˹of gold˺. Yet all this is no more than a ˹fleeting˺ enjoyment in this worldly life. ˹But˺ the Hereafter with your Lord is ˹only˺ for those mindful ˹of Him˺
translations.arberry: and ornaments; surely all this is but the enjoyment of the present life, and the world to come with thy Lord is for the godfearing.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

translations.saheeh: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."
translations.pickthall: And verily We sent Moses with Our revelations unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, and he said: I am a messenger of the Lord of the Worlds.
translations.khattab: Indeed, We sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his chiefs, and he said: “I am a messenger of the Lord of all worlds.”
translations.arberry: We also sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his Council, and he said, 'Surely, I am the Messenger of the Lord of all Being.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَقَالُواْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهۡتَدُونَ

translations.saheeh: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."
translations.pickthall: And they said: O wizard! Entreat thy Lord for us by the pact that He hath made with thee. Lo! we verily will walk aright.
translations.khattab: ˹Then˺ they pleaded, “O ˹mighty˺ magician! Pray to your Lord on our behalf, by virtue of the covenant He made with you. We will certainly accept guidance.”
translations.arberry: And they said, 'Sorcerer, pray to thy Lord for us by the covenant He has made with thee, and surely we shall be right-guided.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطࣱ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."
translations.pickthall: Lo! Allah, He is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him. This is a right path.
translations.khattab: Surely Allah ˹alone˺ is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him ˹alone˺. This is the Straight Path.”
translations.arberry: Assuredly God is my Lord and your Lord; therefore serve Him; this is a straight path.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطࣱ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."
translations.pickthall: Lo! Allah, He is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him. This is a right path.
translations.khattab: Surely Allah ˹alone˺ is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him ˹alone˺. This is the Straight Path.”
translations.arberry: Assuredly God is my Lord and your Lord; therefore serve Him; this is a straight path.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَنَادَوۡاْ يَٰمَٰلِكُ لِيَقۡضِ عَلَيۡنَا رَبُّكَۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّٰكِثُونَ

translations.saheeh: And they will call, "O Malik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."
translations.pickthall: And they cry: O master! Let thy Lord make an end of us. He saith: Lo! here ye must remain.
translations.khattab: They will cry, “O Mâlik! Let your Lord finish us off.” He will answer, “You are definitely here to stay.”
translations.arberry: And they shall call, 'O

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

translations.saheeh: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
translations.pickthall: Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, from that which they ascribe (unto Him)!
translations.khattab: Glorified is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, far above what they claim
translations.arberry: Glory be to the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, above that they describe.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

translations.saheeh: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
translations.pickthall: Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, from that which they ascribe (unto Him)!
translations.khattab: Glorified is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, far above what they claim
translations.arberry: Glory be to the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, above that they describe.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمࣱ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ

translations.saheeh: And [Allah acknowledges] his saying, "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."
translations.pickthall: And he saith: O my Lord! Lo! these are a folk who believe not.
translations.khattab: ˹Allah is Aware of˺ the Prophet’s cry: “O my Lord! Indeed, these are a people who persist in disbelief.”
translations.arberry: And for his saying, 'My Lord, surely these are a people who believe not' --

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: رَحۡمَةࣰ مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

translations.saheeh: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
translations.pickthall: A mercy from thy Lord. Lo! He, even He is the Hearer, the Knower,
translations.khattab: as a mercy from your Lord. He ˹alone˺ is truly the All-Hearing, All-Knowing—
translations.arberry: as a mercy from thy Lord (surely He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing)

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

translations.saheeh: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.
translations.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye would be sure.
translations.khattab: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, if only you had sure faith
translations.arberry: Lord of the heavens and earth, and all that between them is if you have faith.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

translations.saheeh: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.
translations.pickthall: There is no Allah save Him. He quickeneth and giveth death; your Lord and Lord of your forefathers.
translations.khattab: There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. He ˹alone˺ gives life and causes death. ˹He is˺ your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers
translations.arberry: There is no god but He; He gives life and makes to die; your Lord and the Lord of your fathers, the ancients.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ

translations.saheeh: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.
translations.pickthall: There is no Allah save Him. He quickeneth and giveth death; your Lord and Lord of your forefathers.
translations.khattab: There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. He ˹alone˺ gives life and causes death. ˹He is˺ your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers
translations.arberry: There is no god but He; He gives life and makes to die; your Lord and the Lord of your fathers, the ancients.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: رَّبَّنَا ٱكۡشِفۡ عَنَّا ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤۡمِنُونَ

translations.saheeh: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."
translations.pickthall: (Then they will say): Our Lord relieve us of the torment. Lo! we are believers.
translations.khattab: Our Lord! Remove ˹this˺ torment from us, ˹and˺ we will certainly believe.”
translations.arberry: 'O our Lord, remove Thou from us the chastisement; we are believers.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَإِنِّي عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمۡ أَن تَرۡجُمُونِ

translations.saheeh: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.
translations.pickthall: And lo! I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me to death.
translations.khattab: And indeed, I seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord so you do not stone me ˹to death˺
translations.arberry: and I take refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you should stone me.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَإِنِّي عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمۡ أَن تَرۡجُمُونِ

translations.saheeh: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.
translations.pickthall: And lo! I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me to death.
translations.khattab: And indeed, I seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord so you do not stone me ˹to death˺
translations.arberry: and I take refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you should stone me.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمࣱ مُّجۡرِمُونَ

translations.saheeh: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.
translations.pickthall: And he cried unto his Lord, (saying): These are guilty folk.
translations.khattab: Ultimately, he cried out to his Lord, “These are a wicked people!”
translations.arberry: And he called to his Lord, saying, 'These are a sinful people.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَضۡلࣰ ا مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ

translations.saheeh: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.
translations.pickthall: A bounty from thy Lord. That is the supreme triumph.
translations.khattab: as ˹an act of˺ grace from your Lord. That is ˹truly˺ the ultimate triumph
translations.arberry: a bounty from thy Lord; that is the mighty triumph.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: هَٰذَا هُدࣰ ىۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَهُمۡ عَذَابࣱ مِّن رِّجۡزٍ أَلِيمٌ

translations.saheeh: This [Qur'an] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature.
translations.pickthall: This is guidance. And those who disbelieve the revelations of their Lord, for them there is a painful doom of wrath.
translations.khattab: This ˹Quran˺ is ˹true˺ guidance. And those who deny their Lord’s revelations will suffer the ˹worst˺ torment of agonizing pain
translations.arberry: This is guidance; and those who disbelieve in the signs of their Lord, there awaits them a painful chastisement of wrath.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: مَنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحࣰ ا فَلِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَنۡ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيۡهَاۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمۡ تُرۡجَعُونَ

translations.saheeh: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against the self. Then to your Lord you will be returned.
translations.pickthall: Whoso doeth right, it is for his soul, and whoso doeth wrong, it is against it. And afterward unto your Lord ye will be brought back.
translations.khattab: Whoever does good, it is to their own benefit. And whoever does evil, it is to their own loss. Then to your Lord you will ˹all˺ be returned
translations.arberry: Whoso does righteousness, it is to his own gain, and whoso does evil, it is to his own loss; then to your Lord you shall be returned.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم بَيِّنَٰتࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِۖ فَمَا ٱخۡتَلَفُوٓاْ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡعِلۡمُ بَغۡيَۢا بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقۡضِي بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ

translations.saheeh: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
translations.pickthall: And gave them plain commandments. And they differed not until after the knowledge came unto them, through rivalry among themselves. Lo! thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein they used to differ.
translations.khattab: We ˹also˺ gave them clear commandments regarding ˹their˺ faith. But it was not until knowledge came to them that they differed out of mutual envy. Surely your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Judgment regarding their differences
translations.arberry: We gave them clear signs of the Command; so they differed not, except after the knowledge had come to them, being insolent one to another. Surely thy Lord will decide between them on the Day of Resurrection touching their differences.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَيُدۡخِلُهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ

translations.saheeh: So as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is what is the clear attainment.
translations.pickthall: Then, as for those who believed and did good works, their Lord will bring them in unto His mercy. That is the evident triumph.
translations.khattab: As for those who believed and did good, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is ˹truly˺ the absolute triumph
translations.arberry: And as for those who have believed and done deeds of righteousness, their Lord shall admit them into His mercy; that is the manifest triumph.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَرَبِّ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

translations.saheeh: Then, to Allah belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.
translations.pickthall: Then praise be to Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, the Lord of the Worlds.
translations.khattab: So all praise is for Allah—Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of all worlds
translations.arberry: So to God belongs praise, the Lord of the heavens and the Lord of the earth, Lord of all Being.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَرَبِّ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

translations.saheeh: Then, to Allah belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.
translations.pickthall: Then praise be to Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, the Lord of the Worlds.
translations.khattab: So all praise is for Allah—Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of all worlds
translations.arberry: So to God belongs praise, the Lord of the heavens and the Lord of the earth, Lord of all Being.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَرَبِّ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

translations.saheeh: Then, to Allah belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.
translations.pickthall: Then praise be to Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, the Lord of the Worlds.
translations.khattab: So all praise is for Allah—Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of all worlds
translations.arberry: So to God belongs praise, the Lord of the heavens and the Lord of the earth, Lord of all Being.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ فَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ

translations.saheeh: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allah," and then remained on a right course - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
translations.pickthall: Lo! those who say: Our Lord is Allah, and thereafter walk aright, there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.
translations.khattab: Surely those who say, “Our Lord is Allah,” and then remain steadfast—there will be no fear for them, nor will they grieve
translations.arberry: Surely those who say, 'Our Lord is God' and then go straight, no fear shall be on them, neither shall they sorrow.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَوَصَّيۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيۡهِ إِحۡسَٰنًاۖ حَمَلَتۡهُ أُمُّهُۥ كُرۡهࣰ ا وَوَضَعَتۡهُ كُرۡهࣰ اۖ وَحَمۡلُهُۥ وَفِصَٰلُهُۥ ثَلَٰثُونَ شَهۡرًاۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَبَلَغَ أَرۡبَعِينَ سَنَةࣰ قَالَ رَبِّ أَوۡزِعۡنِيٓ أَنۡ أَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَيَّ وَأَنۡ أَعۡمَلَ صَٰلِحࣰ ا تَرۡضَىٰهُ وَأَصۡلِحۡ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِيٓۖ إِنِّي تُبۡتُ إِلَيۡكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ

translations.saheeh: And We have enjoined upon man, to his parents, good treatment. His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his gestation and weaning [period] is thirty months. [He grows] until, when he reaches maturity and reaches [the age of] forty years, he says, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims."
translations.pickthall: And We have commended unto man kindness toward parents. His mother beareth him with reluctance, and bringeth him forth with reluctance, and the bearing of him and the weaning of him is thirty months, till, when he attaineth full strength and reacheth forty years, he saith: My Lord! Arouse me that I may give thanks for the favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and that I may do right acceptable unto Thee. And be gracious unto me in the matter of my seed. Lo! I have turned unto Thee repentant, and lo! I am of those who surrender (unto Thee).
translations.khattab: We have commanded people to honour their parents. Their mothers bore them in hardship and delivered them in hardship. Their ˹period of˺ bearing and weaning is thirty months. In time, when the child reaches their prime at the age of forty, they pray, “My Lord! Inspire me to ˹always˺ be thankful for Your favours which You blessed me and my parents with, and to do good deeds that please You. And instil righteousness in my offspring. I truly repent to You, and I truly submit ˹to Your Will˺.”
translations.arberry: We have charged man, that he be kind to his parents; his mother bore him painfully, and painfully she gave birth to him; his bearing and his weaning are thirty months. Until, when he is fully grown, and reaches forty years, he says, 'O my Lord, dispose me that I may be thankful for Thy blessing wherewith Thou hast blessed me and my father and mother, and that I may do righteousness well-pleasing to Thee; and make me righteous also in my seed. Behold, I repent to Thee, and am among those that surrender.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَيۡءِۭ بِأَمۡرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصۡبَحُواْ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَٰكِنُهُمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ

translations.saheeh: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people.
translations.pickthall: Destroying all things by commandment of its Lord. And morning found them so that naught could be seen save their dwellings. Thus do We reward the guilty folk.
translations.khattab: It destroyed everything by the command of its Lord, leaving nothing visible except their ruins. This is how We reward the wicked people
translations.arberry: destroying everything by the commandment of its Lord.' So in the morning there was naught to be seen but their dwelling-places. Even so do We recompense the people of the sinners.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَيَوۡمَ يُعۡرَضُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ أَلَيۡسَ هَٰذَا بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَاۚ قَالَ فَذُوقُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُونَ

translations.saheeh: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will say, "Then taste the punishment because you used to disbelieve."
translations.pickthall: And on the day when those who disbelieve are exposed to the Fire (they will be asked): Is not this real? They will say: Yea, by our Lord. He will say: Then taste the doom for that ye disbelieved.
translations.khattab: And on the Day the disbelievers will be exposed to the Fire, ˹they will be asked,˺ “Is this ˹Hereafter˺ not the truth?” They will cry, “Absolutely, by our Lord!” It will be said, “Then taste the punishment for your disbelief.”
translations.arberry: Upon the day when the unbelievers are exposed to the Fire: 'Is not this the truth?' They shall say, 'Yes, by our Lord!' He shall say, 'Then taste the chastisement of your unbelief!'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَءَامَنُواْ بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدࣲ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمۡ كَفَّرَ عَنۡهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمۡ وَأَصۡلَحَ بَالَهُمۡ

translations.saheeh: And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muhammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition.
translations.pickthall: And those who believe and do good works and believe in that which is revealed unto Muhammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He riddeth them of their ill-deeds and improveth their state.
translations.khattab: As for those who believe, do good, and have faith in what has been revealed to Muḥammad—which is the truth from their Lord—He will absolve them of their sins and improve their condition
translations.arberry: But those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what is sent down to Muhammad -- and it is the truth from their Lord -- He will acquit them of their evil deeds, and dispose their minds aright.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ٱتَّبَعُواْ ٱلۡبَٰطِلَ وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّبَعُواْ ٱلۡحَقَّ مِن رَّبِّهِمۡۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضۡرِبُ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ أَمۡثَٰلَهُمۡ

translations.saheeh: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, and those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus does Allah present to the people their comparisons.
translations.pickthall: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood and because those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus Allah coineth their similitudes for mankind.
translations.khattab: This is because the disbelievers follow falsehood, while the believers follow the truth from their Lord. This is how Allah shows people their true state ˹of faith˺
translations.arberry: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, and those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Even so God strikes their similitudes for men.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةࣲ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ كَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُۥ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُم

translations.saheeh: So is he who is on clear evidence from his Lord like him to whom the evil of his work has been made attractive and they follow their [own] desires?
translations.pickthall: Is he who relieth on a clear proof from his Lord like those for whom the evil that they do is beautified while they follow their own lusts?
translations.khattab: Can those ˹believers˺ who stand on clear proof from their Lord be like those whose evil deeds are made appealing to them and ˹only˺ follow their desires
translations.arberry: What, is he who is upon a clear sign from his Lord like unto such a one unto whom his evil deeds have been decked out fair, and they have followed their caprices?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: مَّثَلُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِي وُعِدَ ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَۖ فِيهَآ أَنۡهَٰرࣱ مِّن مَّآءٍ غَيۡرِ ءَاسِنࣲ وَأَنۡهَٰرࣱ مِّن لَّبَنࣲ لَّمۡ يَتَغَيَّرۡ طَعۡمُهُۥ وَأَنۡهَٰرࣱ مِّنۡ خَمۡرࣲ لَّذَّةࣲ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ وَأَنۡهَٰرࣱ مِّنۡ عَسَلࣲ مُّصَفࣰّ ىۖ وَلَهُمۡ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ وَمَغۡفِرَةࣱ مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡۖ كَمَنۡ هُوَ خَٰلِدࣱ فِي ٱلنَّارِ وَسُقُواْ مَآءً حَمِيمࣰ ا فَقَطَّعَ أَمۡعَآءَهُمۡ

translations.saheeh: Is the description of Paradise, which the righteous are promised, wherein are rivers of water unaltered, rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink, and rivers of purified honey, in which they will have from all [kinds of] fruits and forgiveness from their Lord, like [that of] those who abide eternally in the Fire and are given to drink scalding water that will sever their intestines?
translations.pickthall: A similitude of the Garden which those who keep their duty (to Allah) are promised: Therein are rivers of water unpolluted, and rivers of milk whereof the flavour changeth not, and rivers of wine delicious to the drinkers, and rivers of clear-run honey; therein for them is every kind of fruit, with pardon from their Lord. (Are those who enjoy all this) like those who are immortal in the Fire and are given boiling water to drink so that it teareth their bowels?
translations.khattab: The description of the Paradise promised to the righteous is that in it are rivers of fresh water, rivers of milk that never changes in taste, rivers of wine delicious to drink, and rivers of pure honey. There they will ˹also˺ have all kinds of fruit, and forgiveness from their Lord. ˹Can they be˺ like those who will stay in the Fire forever, left to drink boiling water that will tear apart their insides
translations.arberry: This is the similitude of Paradise which the godfearing have been promised: therein are rivers of water unstaling, rivers of milk unchanging in flavour, and rivers of wine -- a delight to the drinkers, rivers, too, of honey purified; and therein for them is every fruit, and forgiveness from their Lord -- Are they as he who dwells forever in the Fire, such as are given to drink boiling water, that tears their bowels asunder?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ۞قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطۡغَيۡتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِي ضَلَٰلِۭ بَعِيدࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."
translations.pickthall: His comrade saith: Our Lord! I did not cause him to rebel, but he was (himself) far gone in error.
translations.khattab: One’s ˹devilish˺ associate will say, “Our Lord! I did not make them transgress. Rather, they were far astray ˹on their own˺.”
translations.arberry: And his comrade shall say, 'Our Lord, I made him not insolent, but he was in far error.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ قَبۡلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَقَبۡلَ ٱلۡغُرُوبِ

translations.saheeh: So be patient, [O Muhammad], over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,
translations.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad) bear with what they say, and hymn the praise of thy Lord before the rising and before the setting of the sun;
translations.khattab: So be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And glorify the praises of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset
translations.arberry: So be thou patient under what they say, and proclaim thy Lord's praise before the rising of the sun, and before its setting,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَبۡلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحۡسِنِينَ

translations.saheeh: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
translations.pickthall: Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good;
translations.khattab: ˹joyfully˺ receiving what their Lord will grant them. Before this ˹reward˺ they were truly good-doers ˹in the world˺
translations.arberry: taking whatsoever their Lord has given them; they were good-doers before that.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقࣱّ مِّثۡلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمۡ تَنطِقُونَ

translations.saheeh: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
translations.pickthall: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak.
translations.khattab: Then by the Lord of heaven and earth! ˹All˺ this is certainly as true as ˹the fact that˺ you can speak
translations.arberry: So by the Lord of heaven and earth, it is as surely true as that you have speech.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

translations.saheeh: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."
translations.pickthall: They said: Even so saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise, the Knower.
translations.khattab: They replied, “Such has your Lord decreed. He is truly the All-Wise, All-Knowing.”
translations.arberry: They said, 'So says thy Lord; He is the All-wise, the All-knowing.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ

translations.saheeh: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."
translations.pickthall: Marked by thy Lord for (the destruction of) the wanton.
translations.khattab: marked by your Lord for the transgressors.”
translations.arberry: marked with thy Lord for the prodigal.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَعَتَوۡاْ عَنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ

translations.saheeh: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
translations.pickthall: But they rebelled against their Lord's decree, and so the thunderbolt overtook them even while they gazed;
translations.khattab: Still they persisted in defying the commands of their Lord, so they were overtaken by a ˹mighty˺ blast while they were looking on
translations.arberry: Then they turned in disdain from the commandment of their Lord, and the thunderbolt took them and they themselves beholding

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
translations.pickthall: Lo! the doom of thy Lord will surely come to pass;
translations.khattab: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will come to pass—
translations.arberry: surely thy Lord's chastisement is about to fall;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

translations.saheeh: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
translations.pickthall: Happy because of what their Lord hath given them, and (because) their Lord hath warded off from them the torment of hell-fire.
translations.khattab: enjoying whatever their Lord will have granted them. And their Lord will have protected them from the torment of the Hellfire
translations.arberry: rejoicing in that their Lord has given them; and their Lord shall guard them against the chastisement of Hell.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

translations.saheeh: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
translations.pickthall: Happy because of what their Lord hath given them, and (because) their Lord hath warded off from them the torment of hell-fire.
translations.khattab: enjoying whatever their Lord will have granted them. And their Lord will have protected them from the torment of the Hellfire
translations.arberry: rejoicing in that their Lord has given them; and their Lord shall guard them against the chastisement of Hell.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنࣲ وَلَا مَجۡنُونٍ

translations.saheeh: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
translations.pickthall: Therefor warn (men, O Muhammad). By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman.
translations.khattab: So ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O Prophet˺. For you, by the grace of your Lord, are not a fortune-teller or a madman
translations.arberry: Therefore remind! by thy Lord's blessing thou art not a soothsayer neither possessed.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡمُصَۜيۡطِرُونَ

translations.saheeh: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?
translations.pickthall: Or do they own the treasures of thy Lord? Or have they been given charge (thereof)?
translations.khattab: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord, or are they in control ˹of everything˺
translations.arberry: Or are thy Lord's treasuries in their keeping? Or are they the registrars?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَاۖ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ

translations.saheeh: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.
translations.pickthall: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest,
translations.khattab: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, for you are truly under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes. And glorify the praises of your Lord when you rise
translations.arberry: And be thou patient under the judgment of thy Lord; surely thou art before Our eyes. And proclaim the praise of thy Lord when thou arisest,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَاۖ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ

translations.saheeh: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.
translations.pickthall: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest,
translations.khattab: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, for you are truly under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes. And glorify the praises of your Lord when you rise
translations.arberry: And be thou patient under the judgment of thy Lord; surely thou art before Our eyes. And proclaim the praise of thy Lord when thou arisest,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لَقَدۡ رَأَىٰ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ

translations.saheeh: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.
translations.pickthall: Verily he saw one of the greater revelations of his Lord.
translations.khattab: He certainly saw some of his Lord’s greatest signs
translations.arberry: Indeed, he saw one of the greatest signs of his Lord.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّآ أَسۡمَآءࣱ سَمَّيۡتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلۡطَٰنٍۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهۡوَى ٱلۡأَنفُسُۖ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ

translations.saheeh: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allah has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.
translations.pickthall: They are but names which ye have named, ye and your fathers, for which Allah hath revealed no warrant. They follow but a guess and that which (they) themselves desire. And now the guidance from their Lord hath come unto them.
translations.khattab: These ˹idols˺ are mere names that you and your forefathers have made up—a practice Allah has never authorized. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions and whatever ˹their˺ souls desire, although ˹true˺ guidance has already come to them from their Lord
translations.arberry: They are naught but names yourselves have named, and your fathers; God has sent down no authority touching them. They follow only surmise, and what the souls desire; and yet guidance has come to them from their Lord.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ذَٰلِكَ مَبۡلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ

translations.saheeh: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.
translations.pickthall: Such is their sum of knowledge. Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth, and He is Best Aware of him whom goeth right.
translations.khattab: This is the extent of their knowledge. Surely your Lord knows best who has strayed from His Way and who is ˹rightly˺ guided
translations.arberry: That is their attainment of knowledge. Surely thy Lord knows very well those who have gone astray from His way, and He knows very well those who are guided.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِۚ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِكُمۡ إِذۡ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِذۡ أَنتُمۡ أَجِنَّةࣱ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡۖ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ

translations.saheeh: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.
translations.pickthall: Those who avoid enormities of sin and abominations, save the unwilled offences - (for them) lo! thy Lord is of vast mercy. He is Best Aware of you (from the time) when He created you from the earth, and when ye were hidden in the bellies of your mothers. Therefor ascribe not purity unto yourselves. He is Best Aware of him who wardeth off (evil).
translations.khattab: those who avoid major sins and shameful deeds, despite ˹stumbling on˺ minor sins. Surely your Lord is infinite in forgiveness. He knew well what would become of you as He created you from the earth and while you were ˹still˺ fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not ˹falsely˺ elevate yourselves. He knows best who is ˹truly˺ righteous
translations.arberry: Those who avoid the heinous sins and indecencies, save lesser offences surely thy Lord is wide in His forgiveness. Very well He knows you, when He produced you from the earth, and when you were yet unborn in your mothers' wombs; therefore hold not yourselves purified; God knows very well him who is godfearing.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡمُنتَهَىٰ

translations.saheeh: And that to your Lord is the finality
translations.pickthall: And that thy Lord, He is the goal;
translations.khattab: and that to your Lord ˹alone˺ is the ultimate return ˹of all things˺
translations.arberry: and that the final end is unto thy Lord,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعۡرَىٰ

translations.saheeh: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius
translations.pickthall: And that He it is Who is the Lord of Sirius;
translations.khattab: And He alone is the Lord of Sirius
translations.arberry: and that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ

translations.saheeh: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?
translations.pickthall: Concerning which then, of the bounties of thy Lord, canst thou dispute?
translations.khattab: Now, which of your Lord’s favours will you dispute
translations.arberry: Then which of thy Lord's bounties disputest thou?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَغۡلُوبࣱ فَٱنتَصِرۡ

translations.saheeh: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."
translations.pickthall: So he cried unto his Lord, saying: I am vanquished, so give help.
translations.khattab: So he cried out to his Lord, “I am helpless, so help ˹me˺!”
translations.arberry: And so he called unto his Lord, saying, 'I am vanquished; do Thou succour me!'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you ˹humans and jinn˺ both deny
translations.arberry: O which of your Lord's bounties will you and you deny?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
translations.arberry: O which of your Lord's bounties will you and you deny?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَغۡرِبَيۡنِ

translations.saheeh: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.
translations.pickthall: Lord of the two Easts, and Lord of the two Wests!
translations.khattab: ˹He is˺ Lord of the two easts and the two wests
translations.arberry: Lord of the Two Easts, Lord of the Two Wests,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَغۡرِبَيۡنِ

translations.saheeh: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.
translations.pickthall: Lord of the two Easts, and Lord of the two Wests!
translations.khattab: ˹He is˺ Lord of the two easts and the two wests
translations.arberry: Lord of the Two Easts, Lord of the Two Wests,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
translations.arberry: O which of your Lord's bounties will you and you deny?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
translations.arberry: O which of your Lord's bounties will you and you deny?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
translations.arberry: O which of your Lord's bounties will you and you deny?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
translations.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
translations.arberry: O which of your Lord's bounties will you and you deny?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَيَبۡقَىٰ وَجۡهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلۡجَلَٰلِ وَٱلۡإِكۡرَامِ

translations.saheeh: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
translations.pickthall: There remaineth but the Countenance of thy Lord of Might and Glory.
translations.khattab: Only your Lord Himself, full of Majesty and Honour, will remain ˹forever˺
translations.arberry: yet still abides the Face of thy Lord, majestic, splendid.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.saheeh: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
