all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسۡمُ رَبِّكَ ذِي ٱلۡجَلَٰلِ وَٱلۡإِكۡرَامِ

translations.saheeh: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
translations.pickthall: Blessed be the name of thy Lord, Mighty and glorious!
translations.khattab: Blessed is the Name of your Lord, full of Majesty and Honour
translations.arberry: Blessed be the Name of thy Lord, majestic, splendid.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

translations.saheeh: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
translations.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad), praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
translations.khattab: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest
translations.arberry: Then magnify the Name of thy Lord, the All-mighty.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: تَنزِيلࣱ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

translations.saheeh: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
translations.pickthall: A revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
translations.khattab: ˹It is˺ a revelation from the Lord of all worlds
translations.arberry: a sending down from the Lord of all Being.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

translations.saheeh: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
translations.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad) praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
translations.khattab: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest
translations.arberry: Then magnify the Name of thy Lord, the All-mighty.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمَا لَكُمۡ لَا تُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلرَّسُولُ يَدۡعُوكُمۡ لِتُؤۡمِنُواْ بِرَبِّكُمۡ وَقَدۡ أَخَذَ مِيثَٰقَكُمۡ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ

translations.saheeh: And why do you not believe in Allah while the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord and He has taken your covenant, if you should [truly] be believers?
translations.pickthall: What aileth you that ye believe not in Allah, when the messenger calleth you to believe in your Lord, and He hath already made a covenant with you, if ye are believers?
translations.khattab: Why do you not believe in Allah while the Messenger is inviting you to have faith in your Lord, although He has already taken your covenant, if you will ever believe
translations.arberry: How is it with you, that you believe not in God seeing that the Messenger is calling you to believe in your Lord, and He has taken compact with you, if you are believers?

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦٓ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَۖ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءُ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرُهُمۡ وَنُورُهُمۡۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

translations.saheeh: And those who have believed in Allah and His messengers - those are [in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs, with their Lord. For them is their reward and their light. But those who have disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of Hellfire.
translations.pickthall: And those who believe in Allah and His messengers, they are the loyal, and the martyrs are with their Lord; they have their reward and their light; while as for those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, they are owners of hell-fire.
translations.khattab: ˹As for˺ those who believe in Allah and His messengers, it is they who are ˹truly˺ the people of truth. And the martyrs, with their Lord, will have their reward and their light. But ˹as for˺ those who disbelieve and reject Our signs, it is they who will be the residents of the Hellfire
translations.arberry: And those who believe in God and His Messengers -- they are the just men and the martyrs in their Lord's sight; they have their wage, and their light. But the unbelievers, who have cried lies to Our signs, they are the inhabitants of Hell.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: سَابِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَغۡفِرَةࣲ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرۡضُهَا كَعَرۡضِ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ أُعِدَّتۡ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦۚ ذَٰلِكَ فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤۡتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلۡفَضۡلِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

translations.saheeh: Race toward forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whose width is like the width of the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believed in Allah and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allah which He gives to whom He wills, and Allah is the possessor of great bounty.
translations.pickthall: Race one with another for forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whereof the breadth is as the breadth of the heavens and the earth, which is in store for those who believe in Allah and His messengers. Such is the bounty of Allah, which He bestoweth upon whom He will, and Allah is of Infinite Bounty.
translations.khattab: ˹So˺ compete with one another for forgiveness from your Lord and a Paradise as vast as the heavens and the earth, prepared for those who believe in Allah and His messengers. This is the favour of Allah. He grants it to whoever He wills. And Allah is the Lord of infinite bounty
translations.arberry: Race to forgiveness from your Lord, and a Garden the breadth whereof is as the breadth of heaven and earth, made ready for those who believe in God and His Messengers. That is the bounty of God; He gives it unto whomsoever He will; and God is of bounty abounding.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَآءُو مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَلِإِخۡوَٰنِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِٱلۡإِيمَٰنِ وَلَا تَجۡعَلۡ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلࣰّ ا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ رَءُوفࣱ رَّحِيمٌ

translations.saheeh: And [there is a share for] those who came after them, saying, "Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful."
translations.pickthall: And those who came (into the faith) after them say: Our Lord! Forgive us and our brethren who were before us in the faith, and place not in our hearts any rancour toward those who believe. Our Lord! Thou art Full of Pity, Merciful.
translations.khattab: And those who come after them will pray, “Our Lord! Forgive us and our fellow believers who preceded us in faith, and do not allow bitterness into our hearts towards those who believe. Our Lord! Indeed, You are Ever Gracious, Most Merciful.”
translations.arberry: And as for those who came after them, they say, 'Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers, who preceded us in belief, and put Thou not into our hearts any rancour towards those who believe. Our Lord, surely Thou art the All-gentle, the All-compassionate.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَآءُو مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَلِإِخۡوَٰنِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِٱلۡإِيمَٰنِ وَلَا تَجۡعَلۡ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلࣰّ ا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ رَءُوفࣱ رَّحِيمٌ

translations.saheeh: And [there is a share for] those who came after them, saying, "Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful."
translations.pickthall: And those who came (into the faith) after them say: Our Lord! Forgive us and our brethren who were before us in the faith, and place not in our hearts any rancour toward those who believe. Our Lord! Thou art Full of Pity, Merciful.
translations.khattab: And those who come after them will pray, “Our Lord! Forgive us and our fellow believers who preceded us in faith, and do not allow bitterness into our hearts towards those who believe. Our Lord! Indeed, You are Ever Gracious, Most Merciful.”
translations.arberry: And as for those who came after them, they say, 'Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers, who preceded us in belief, and put Thou not into our hearts any rancour towards those who believe. Our Lord, surely Thou art the All-gentle, the All-compassionate.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: كَمَثَلِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ إِذۡ قَالَ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ ٱكۡفُرۡ فَلَمَّا كَفَرَ قَالَ إِنِّي بَرِيٓءࣱ مِّنكَ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

translations.saheeh: [The hypocrites are] like the example of Satan when he says to man, "Disbelieve." But when he disbelieves, he says, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I fear Allah, Lord of the worlds."
translations.pickthall: (And the hypocrites are) on the likeness of the devil when he telleth man to disbelieve, then, when he disbelieveth saith: Lo! I am quit of thee. Lo! I fear Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.
translations.khattab: ˹They are˺ like Satan when he lures someone to disbelieve. Then after they have done so, he will say ˹on Judgment Day˺, “I have absolutely nothing to do with you. I truly fear Allah—the Lord of all worlds.”
translations.arberry: Like Satan, when he said to man, 'Disbelieve'; then, when he disbelieved, he said, 'Surely I am quit of you. Surely I fear God, the Lord of all Being.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَتَّخِذُواْ عَدُوِّي وَعَدُوَّكُمۡ أَوۡلِيَآءَ تُلۡقُونَ إِلَيۡهِم بِٱلۡمَوَدَّةِ وَقَدۡ كَفَرُواْ بِمَا جَآءَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ يُخۡرِجُونَ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَإِيَّاكُمۡ أَن تُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ رَبِّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ خَرَجۡتُمۡ جِهَٰدࣰ ا فِي سَبِيلِي وَٱبۡتِغَآءَ مَرۡضَاتِيۚ تُسِرُّونَ إِلَيۡهِم بِٱلۡمَوَدَّةِ وَأَنَا۠ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَآ أَخۡفَيۡتُمۡ وَمَآ أَعۡلَنتُمۡۚ وَمَن يَفۡعَلۡهُ مِنكُمۡ فَقَدۡ ضَلَّ سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ

translations.saheeh: O you who have believed, do not take My enemies and your enemies as allies, extending to them affection while they have disbelieved in what came to you of the truth, having driven out the Prophet and yourselves [only] because you believe in Allah, your Lord. If you have come out for jihad in My cause and seeking means to My approval, [take them not as friends]. You confide to them affection, but I am most knowing of what you have concealed and what you have declared. And whoever does it among you has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way.
translations.pickthall: O ye who believe! Choose not My enemy and your enemy for allies. Do ye give them friendship when they disbelieve in that truth which hath come unto you, driving out the messenger and you because ye believe in Allah, your Lord? If ye have come forth to strive in My way and seeking My good pleasure, (show them not friendship). Do ye show friendship unto them in secret, when I am Best Aware of what ye hide and what ye proclaim? And whosoever doeth it among you, he verily hath strayed from the right way.
translations.khattab: O believers! Do not take My enemies and yours as trusted allies, showing them affection even though they deny what has come to you of the truth. They drove the Messenger and yourselves out ˹of Mecca˺, simply for your belief in Allah, your Lord. If you ˹truly˺ emigrated to struggle in My cause and seek My pleasure, ˹then do not take them as allies,˺ disclosing secrets ˹of the believers˺ to the pagans out of affection for them, when I know best whatever you conceal and whatever you reveal. And whoever of you does this has truly strayed from the Right Way
translations.arberry: O believers, take not My enemy and your enemy for friends, offering them love, though they have disbelieved in the truth that has come to you, expelling the Messenger and you because you believe in God your Lord. If you go forth to struggle in My way and seek My good pleasure, secretly loving them, yet I know very well what you conceal and what you publish; and whosoever of you does that, has gone astray from the right way.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: قَدۡ كَانَتۡ لَكُمۡ أُسۡوَةٌ حَسَنَةࣱ فِيٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ إِذۡ قَالُواْ لِقَوۡمِهِمۡ إِنَّا بُرَءَٰٓؤُاْ مِنكُمۡ وَمِمَّا تَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَفَرۡنَا بِكُمۡ وَبَدَا بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكُمُ ٱلۡعَدَٰوَةُ وَٱلۡبَغۡضَآءُ أَبَدًا حَتَّىٰ تُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَحۡدَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَوۡلَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ لِأَبِيهِ لَأَسۡتَغۡفِرَنَّ لَكَ وَمَآ أَمۡلِكُ لَكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَيۡءࣲۖ رَّبَّنَا عَلَيۡكَ تَوَكَّلۡنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ أَنَبۡنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

translations.saheeh: There has already been for you an excellent pattern in Abraham and those with him, when they said to their people, "Indeed, we are disassociated from you and from whatever you worship other than Allah. We have denied you, and there has appeared between us and you animosity and hatred forever until you believe in Allah alone" except for the saying of Abraham to his father, "I will surely ask forgiveness for you, but I have not [power to do] for you anything against Allah. Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.
translations.pickthall: There is a goodly pattern for you in Abraham and those with him, when they told their folk: Lo! we are guiltless of you and all that ye worship beside Allah. We have done with you. And there hath arisen between us and you hostility and hate for ever until ye believe in Allah only - save that which Abraham promised his father (when he said): I will ask forgiveness for thee, though I own nothing for thee from Allah - Our Lord! In Thee we put our trust, and unto Thee we turn repentant, and unto Thee is the journeying.
translations.khattab: You already have an excellent example in Abraham and those with him, when they said to their people, “We totally dissociate ourselves from you and ˹shun˺ whatever ˹idols˺ you worship besides Allah. We reject you. The enmity and hatred that has arisen between us and you will last until you believe in Allah alone.” The only exception is when Abraham said to his father, “I will seek forgiveness for you,˹” adding, “but˺ I cannot protect you from Allah at all.” ˹The believers prayed,˺ “Our Lord! In You we trust. And to You we ˹always˺ turn. And to You is the final return
translations.arberry: You have had a good example in Abraham, and those with him, when they said to their people, 'We are quit of you and that you serve, apart from God. We disbelieve in you, and between us and you enmity has shown itself, and hatred for ever, until you believe in God alone. (Except that Abraham said unto his father, 'Certainly I shall ask pardon for thee; but I have no power to do aught for thee against God.') 'Our Lord, in Thee we trust; to Thee we turn; to Thee is the homecoming.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا فِتۡنَةࣰ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا رَبَّنَآۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

translations.saheeh: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
translations.pickthall: Our Lord! Make us not a prey for those who disbelieve, and forgive us, our Lord! Lo! Thou, only Thou, are the Mighty, the Wise.
translations.khattab: Our Lord! Do not subject us to the persecution of the disbelievers. Forgive us, our Lord! You ˹alone˺ are truly the Almighty, All-Wise.”
translations.arberry: Our Lord, make us not a temptation to those who disbelieve; and forgive us. Our. Lord, Thou art the All-mighty, the All-wise.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا فِتۡنَةࣰ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا رَبَّنَآۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

translations.saheeh: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
translations.pickthall: Our Lord! Make us not a prey for those who disbelieve, and forgive us, our Lord! Lo! Thou, only Thou, are the Mighty, the Wise.
translations.khattab: Our Lord! Do not subject us to the persecution of the disbelievers. Forgive us, our Lord! You ˹alone˺ are truly the Almighty, All-Wise.”
translations.arberry: Our Lord, make us not a temptation to those who disbelieve; and forgive us. Our. Lord, Thou art the All-mighty, the All-wise.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَأَنفِقُواْ مِن مَّا رَزَقۡنَٰكُم مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ فَيَقُولَ رَبِّ لَوۡلَآ أَخَّرۡتَنِيٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلࣲ قَرِيبࣲ فَأَصَّدَّقَ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

translations.saheeh: And spend [in the way of Allah] from what We have provided you before death approaches one of you and he says, "My Lord, if only You would delay me for a brief term so I would give charity and be among the righteous."
translations.pickthall: And spend of that wherewith We have provided you before death cometh unto one of you and he saith: My Lord! If only thou wouldst reprieve me for a little while, then I would give alms and be among the righteous.
translations.khattab: And donate from what We have provided for you before death comes to one of you, and you cry, “My Lord! If only You delayed me for a short while, I would give in charity and be one of the righteous.”
translations.arberry: Expend of what We have provided you before that death comes upon one of you and he says, 'O my Lord, if only Thou wouldst defer me unto a near term, so that I may make freewill offering, and so I may become one of the righteous.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: زَعَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَن لَّن يُبۡعَثُواْۚ قُلۡ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّي لَتُبۡعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلۡتُمۡۚ وَذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected. Say, "Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did. And that, for Allah, is easy."
translations.pickthall: Those who disbelieve assert that they will not be raised again. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Yea, verily, by my Lord! ye will be raised again and then ye will be informed of what ye did; and that is easy for Allah.
translations.khattab: The disbelievers claim they will not be resurrected. Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected, then you will certainly be informed of what you have done. And that is easy for Allah.”
translations.arberry: The unbelievers assert that they will never be raised up. Say: 'Yes indeed, by my Lord! You shall be raised up, then you shall be told the things you did. That is easy for God.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ إِذَا طَلَّقۡتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَأَحۡصُواْ ٱلۡعِدَّةَۖ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمۡۖ لَا تُخۡرِجُوهُنَّ مِنۢ بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلَا يَخۡرُجۡنَ إِلَّآ أَن يَأۡتِينَ بِفَٰحِشَةࣲ مُّبَيِّنَةࣲۚ وَتِلۡكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِۚ وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ فَقَدۡ ظَلَمَ نَفۡسَهُۥۚ لَا تَدۡرِي لَعَلَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحۡدِثُ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ أَمۡرࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: O Prophet, when you [Muslims] divorce women, divorce them for [the commencement of] their waiting period and keep count of the waiting period, and fear Allah, your Lord. Do not turn them out of their [husbands'] houses, nor should they [themselves] leave [during that period] unless they are committing a clear immorality. And those are the limits [set by] Allah. And whoever transgresses the limits of Allah has certainly wronged himself. You know not; perhaps Allah will bring about after that a [different] matter.
translations.pickthall: O Prophet! When ye (men) put away women, put them away for their (legal) period and reckon the period, and keep your duty to Allah, your Lord. Expel them not from their houses nor let them go forth unless they commit open immorality. Such are the limits (imposed by) Allah; and whoso transgresseth Allah's limits, he verily wrongeth his soul. Thou knowest not: it may be that Allah will afterward bring some new thing to pass.
translations.khattab: O Prophet! ˹Instruct the believers:˺ When you ˹intend to˺ divorce women, then divorce them with concern for their waiting period, and count it accurately. And fear Allah, your Lord. Do not force them out of their homes, nor should they leave—unless they commit a blatant misconduct. These are the limits set by Allah. And whoever transgresses Allah’s limits has truly wronged his own soul. You never know, perhaps Allah will bring about a change ˹of heart˺ later
translations.arberry: O Prophet, when you divorce women, divorce them when they have reached their period. Count the period, and fear God your Lord. Do not expel them from their houses, nor let them go forth, except when they commit a flagrant indecency. Those are God's bounds; whosoever trespasses the bounds of God has done wrong to himself. Thou knowest not, perchance after that God will bring something new to pass.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ عَتَتۡ عَنۡ أَمۡرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِۦ فَحَاسَبۡنَٰهَا حِسَابࣰ ا شَدِيدࣰ ا وَعَذَّبۡنَٰهَا عَذَابࣰ ا نُّكۡرࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: And how many a city was insolent toward the command of its Lord and His messengers, so We took it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment.
translations.pickthall: And how many a community revolted against the ordinance of its Lord and His messengers, and We called it to a stern account and punished it with dire punishment,
translations.khattab: ˹Imagine˺ how many societies rebelled against the commandments of their Lord and His messengers, so We called each ˹society˺ to a severe account and subjected them to a horrible punishment
translations.arberry: How many a city turned in disdain from the commandment of its Lord and His Messengers; and then We made with it a terrible reckoning and chastised it with a horrible chastisement.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّهُۥٓ إِن طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَن يُبۡدِلَهُۥٓ أَزۡوَٰجًا خَيۡرࣰ ا مِّنكُنَّ مُسۡلِمَٰتࣲ مُّؤۡمِنَٰتࣲ قَٰنِتَٰتࣲ تَٰٓئِبَٰتٍ عَٰبِدَٰتࣲ سَٰٓئِحَٰتࣲ ثَيِّبَٰتࣲ وَأَبۡكَارࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: Perhaps his Lord, if he divorced you [all], would substitute for him wives better than you - submitting [to Allah], believing, devoutly obedient, repentant, worshipping, and traveling - [ones] previously married and virgins.
translations.pickthall: It may happen that his Lord, if he divorce you, will give him in your stead wives better than you, submissive (to Allah), believing, pious, penitent, devout, inclined to fasting, widows and maids.
translations.khattab: Perhaps, if he were to divorce you ˹all˺, his Lord would replace you with better wives who are submissive ˹to Allah˺, faithful ˹to Him˺, devout, repentant, dedicated to worship and fasting—previously married or virgins
translations.arberry: It is possible that, if he divorces you, his Lord will give him in exchange wives better than you, women who have surrendered, believing, obedient, penitent, devout, given to fasting, who have been married and virgins too.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ تُوبُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوۡبَةࣰ نَّصُوحًا عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمۡ أَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمۡ وَيُدۡخِلَكُمۡ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ يَوۡمَ لَا يُخۡزِي ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّبِيَّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥۖ نُورُهُمۡ يَسۡعَىٰ بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَبِأَيۡمَٰنِهِمۡ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ أَتۡمِمۡ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَآۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: O you who have believed, repent to Allah with sincere repentance. Perhaps your Lord will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow [on] the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will proceed before them and on their right; they will say, "Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent."
translations.pickthall: O ye who believe! Turn unto Allah in sincere repentance! It may be that your Lord will remit from you your evil deeds and bring you into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, on the day when Allah will not abase the Prophet and those who believe with him. Their light will run before them and on their right hands; they will say: Our Lord! Perfect our light for us, and forgive us! Lo! Thou art Able to do all things.
translations.khattab: O believers! Turn to Allah in sincere repentance, so your Lord may absolve you of your sins and admit you into Gardens, under which rivers flow, on the Day Allah will not disgrace the Prophet or the believers with him. Their light will shine ahead of them and on their right. They will say, “Our Lord! Perfect our light for us, and forgive us. ˹For˺ You are truly Most Capable of everything.”
translations.arberry: Believers, turn to God in sincere repentance; it may be that your Lord will acquit you of your evil deeds, and will admit you into gardens underneath which rivers flow. Upon the day when God will not degrade the Prophet and those who believe with him, their light running before them, and on their right hands; and they say, 'Our 'Lord, perfect for us our light, and forgive us; surely Thou art powerful over everything.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ تُوبُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوۡبَةࣰ نَّصُوحًا عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمۡ أَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمۡ وَيُدۡخِلَكُمۡ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ يَوۡمَ لَا يُخۡزِي ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّبِيَّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥۖ نُورُهُمۡ يَسۡعَىٰ بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَبِأَيۡمَٰنِهِمۡ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ أَتۡمِمۡ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَآۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: O you who have believed, repent to Allah with sincere repentance. Perhaps your Lord will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow [on] the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will proceed before them and on their right; they will say, "Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent."
translations.pickthall: O ye who believe! Turn unto Allah in sincere repentance! It may be that your Lord will remit from you your evil deeds and bring you into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, on the day when Allah will not abase the Prophet and those who believe with him. Their light will run before them and on their right hands; they will say: Our Lord! Perfect our light for us, and forgive us! Lo! Thou art Able to do all things.
translations.khattab: O believers! Turn to Allah in sincere repentance, so your Lord may absolve you of your sins and admit you into Gardens, under which rivers flow, on the Day Allah will not disgrace the Prophet or the believers with him. Their light will shine ahead of them and on their right. They will say, “Our Lord! Perfect our light for us, and forgive us. ˹For˺ You are truly Most Capable of everything.”
translations.arberry: Believers, turn to God in sincere repentance; it may be that your Lord will acquit you of your evil deeds, and will admit you into gardens underneath which rivers flow. Upon the day when God will not degrade the Prophet and those who believe with him, their light running before them, and on their right hands; and they say, 'Our 'Lord, perfect for us our light, and forgive us; surely Thou art powerful over everything.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلࣰ ا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱمۡرَأَتَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِذۡ قَالَتۡ رَبِّ ٱبۡنِ لِي عِندَكَ بَيۡتࣰ ا فِي ٱلۡجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِي مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِي مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

translations.saheeh: And Allah presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people."
translations.pickthall: And Allah citeth an example for those who believe: the wife of Pharaoh when she said: My Lord! Build for me a home with thee in the Garden, and deliver me from Pharaoh and his work, and deliver me from evil-doing folk;
translations.khattab: And Allah sets forth an example for the believers: the wife of Pharaoh, who prayed, “My Lord! Build me a house in Paradise near You, deliver me from Pharaoh and his ˹evil˺ doing, and save me from the wrongdoing people.”
translations.arberry: God has struck a similitude for the believers -- the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, 'My Lord, build for me a house in Paradise, in Thy presence, and deliver me from Pharaoh and his work, and do Thou deliver me from the people of the evildoers.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمَرۡيَمَ ٱبۡنَتَ عِمۡرَٰنَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَحۡصَنَتۡ فَرۡجَهَا فَنَفَخۡنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتۡ بِكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَكَانَتۡ مِنَ ٱلۡقَٰنِتِينَ

translations.saheeh: And [the example of] Mary, the daughter of 'Imran, who guarded her chastity, so We blew into [her garment] through Our angel, and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures and was of the devoutly obedient.
translations.pickthall: And Mary, daughter of 'Imran, whose body was chaste, therefor We breathed therein something of Our Spirit. And she put faith in the words of her Lord and His scriptures, and was of the obedient.
translations.khattab: ˹There is˺ also ˹the example of˺ Mary, the daughter of ’Imrân, who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her ˹womb˺ through Our angel ˹Gabriel˺. She testified to the words of her Lord and His Scriptures, and was one of the ˹sincerely˺ devout
translations.arberry: And Mary, Imran's daughter, who guarded her virginity, so We breathed into her of Our Spirit, and she confirmed the Words of her Lord and His Books, and became one of the obedient.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِرَبِّهِمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَۖ وَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

translations.saheeh: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.
translations.pickthall: And for those who disbelieve in their Lord there is the doom of hell, a hapless journey's end!
translations.khattab: Those who disbelieve in their Lord will suffer the punishment of Hell. What an evil destination
translations.arberry: And for those who disbelieve in their Lord there awaits the chastisement of Gehenna -- an evil homecoming!

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةࣱ وَأَجۡرࣱ كَبِيرࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.
translations.pickthall: Lo! those who fear their Lord in secret, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward.
translations.khattab: Indeed, those in awe of their Lord without seeing Him will have forgiveness and a mighty reward
translations.arberry: Surely those who fear their Lord in the Unseen -- there awaits them forgiveness and a great wage.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجۡنُونࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: You are not, [O Muhammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.
translations.pickthall: Thou art not, for thy Lord's favour unto thee, a madman.
translations.khattab: By the grace of your Lord, you ˹O Prophet˺ are not insane
translations.arberry: thou art not, by the blessing of thy Lord, a man possessed.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ

translations.saheeh: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
translations.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth from His way, and He is Best Aware of those who walk aright.
translations.khattab: Surely your Lord ˹alone˺ knows best who has strayed from His Way and who is ˹rightly˺ guided
translations.arberry: Surely thy Lord knows very well those who have gone astray from His way, and He knows very well those who are guided.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَطَافَ عَلَيۡهَا طَآئِفࣱ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمۡ نَآئِمُونَ

translations.saheeh: So there came upon the garden an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.
translations.pickthall: Then a visitation from thy Lord came upon it while they slept
translations.khattab: Then it was struck by a torment from your Lord while they slept
translations.arberry: Then a visitation from thy Lord visited it, while they were sleeping,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ

translations.saheeh: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
translations.pickthall: They said: Glorified be our Lord! Lo! we have been wrong-doers.
translations.khattab: They replied, “Glory be to our Lord! We have truly been wrongdoers.”
translations.arberry: They said, 'Glory be to God, our Lord; truly, we were evildoers.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبۡدِلَنَا خَيۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ

translations.saheeh: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."
translations.pickthall: It may be that our Lord will give us better than this in place thereof. Lo! we beseech our Lord.
translations.khattab: We trust our Lord will give us a better garden than this, ˹for˺ we are indeed turning to our Lord with hope.”
translations.arberry: It may be that our Lord will give us in exchange a better than it; to our Lord we humbly turn.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبۡدِلَنَا خَيۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ

translations.saheeh: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."
translations.pickthall: It may be that our Lord will give us better than this in place thereof. Lo! we beseech our Lord.
translations.khattab: We trust our Lord will give us a better garden than this, ˹for˺ we are indeed turning to our Lord with hope.”
translations.arberry: It may be that our Lord will give us in exchange a better than it; to our Lord we humbly turn.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

translations.saheeh: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.
translations.pickthall: Lo! for those who keep from evil are gardens of bliss with their Lord.
translations.khattab: Indeed, the righteous will have the Gardens of Bliss with their Lord
translations.arberry: Surely for the godfearing shall be Gardens of Bliss with their Lord.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلۡحُوتِ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكۡظُومࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muhammad], and be not like the companion of the fish when he called out while he was distressed.
translations.pickthall: But wait thou for thy Lord's decree, and be not like him of the fish, who cried out in despair.
translations.khattab: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not be like ˹Jonah,˺ the Man of the Whale, who cried out ˹to Allah˺, in total distress
translations.arberry: So be thou patient under the judgment of thy Lord, and be not as the Man of the Fish, when he called, choking inwardly.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لَّوۡلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعۡمَةࣱ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلۡعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذۡمُومࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: If not that a favor from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.
translations.pickthall: Had it not been that favour from his Lord had reached him he surely had been cast into the wilderness while he was reprobate.
translations.khattab: Had he not been shown grace by his Lord, he would have certainly been cast onto the open ˹shore˺, still blameworthy
translations.arberry: Had there not overtaken him a blessing from his Lord he would have been cast upon the wilderness, being condemned.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَٱجۡتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

translations.saheeh: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.
translations.pickthall: But his Lord chose him and placed him among the righteous.
translations.khattab: Then his Lord chose him, making him one of the righteous
translations.arberry: But his Lord had chosen him, and He placed him among the righteous.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَعَصَوۡاْ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ أَخۡذَةࣰ رَّابِيَةً

translations.saheeh: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
translations.pickthall: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, therefor did He grip them with a tightening grip.
translations.khattab: each disobeying their Lord’s messenger, so He seized them with a crushing grip
translations.arberry: and they rebelled against the Messenger of their Lord, and He seized them with a surpassing grip.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلۡمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرۡجَآئِهَاۚ وَيَحۡمِلُ عَرۡشَ رَبِّكَ فَوۡقَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ ثَمَٰنِيَةࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].
translations.pickthall: And the angels will be on the sides thereof, and eight will uphold the Throne of thy Lord that day, above them.
translations.khattab: with the angels on its sides. On that Day eight ˹mighty angels˺ will bear the Throne of your Lord above them
translations.arberry: and the angels shall stand upon its borders, and upon that day eight shall carry above them the Throne of thy Lord.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: تَنزِيلࣱ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ

translations.saheeh: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
translations.pickthall: It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
translations.khattab: ˹It is˺ a revelation from the Lord of all worlds
translations.arberry: A sending down from the Lord of all Being.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

translations.saheeh: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
translations.pickthall: So glorify the name of thy Tremendous Lord.
translations.khattab: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest
translations.arberry: Then magnify the Name of thy Lord, the All-mighty.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشۡفِقُونَ

translations.saheeh: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -
translations.pickthall: And those who are fearful of their Lord's doom -
translations.khattab: and those who fear the punishment of their Lord—
translations.arberry: and go in fear of the chastisement of their Lord

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمۡ غَيۡرُ مَأۡمُونࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -
translations.pickthall: Lo! the doom of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure -
translations.khattab: ˹knowing that˺ none should feel secure from their Lord’s punishment—
translations.arberry: (from their Lord's chastisement none feels secure)

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ

translations.saheeh: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able
translations.pickthall: But nay! I swear by the Lord of the rising-places and the setting-places of the planets that We verily are Able
translations.khattab: So, I do swear by the Lord of ˹all˺ the points of sunrise and sunset that We are truly capable
translations.arberry: No! I swear by the Lord of the Easts and Wests, surely We are able

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي دَعَوۡتُ قَوۡمِي لَيۡلࣰ ا وَنَهَارࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.
translations.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Lo! I have called unto my people night and day
translations.khattab: He cried, “My Lord! I have surely called my people day and night
translations.arberry: He said; 'My Lord, I have called my people by night and by day,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَقُلۡتُ ٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
translations.pickthall: And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving.
translations.khattab: saying, ‘Seek your Lord’s forgiveness, ˹for˺ He is truly Most Forgiving
translations.arberry: and I said, "Ask you forgiveness of your Lord; surely He is ever All-forgiving,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: قَالَ نُوحࣱ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمۡ عَصَوۡنِي وَٱتَّبَعُواْ مَن لَّمۡ يَزِدۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.
translations.pickthall: Noah said: My Lord! Lo! they have disobeyed me and followed one whose wealth and children increase him in naught save ruin;
translations.khattab: ˹Eventually,˺ Noah cried, “My Lord! They have certainly persisted in disobeying me, and followed ˹instead˺ those ˹elite˺ whose ˹abundant˺ wealth and children only increase them in loss
translations.arberry: Noah said, 'My Lord, they have rebelled against me, and followed him whose wealth and children increase him only in loss,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَقَالَ نُوحࣱ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرۡ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا

translations.saheeh: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.
translations.pickthall: And Noah said: My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land.
translations.khattab: Noah had prayed, “My Lord! Do not leave a single disbeliever on earth
translations.arberry: And Noah said, 'My Lord, leave not upon the earth of the unbelievers even one.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنࣰ ا وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارَۢا

translations.saheeh: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
translations.pickthall: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and him who entereth my house believing, and believing men and believing women, and increase not the wrong-doers in aught save ruin.
translations.khattab: My Lord! Forgive me, my parents, and whoever enters my house in faith, and ˹all˺ believing men and women. And increase the wrongdoers only in destruction.”
translations.arberry: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whosoever enters my house as a believer, and the believers, men and women alike; and do Thou not increase the evildoers save in ruin!'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشۡدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ وَلَن نُّشۡرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
translations.pickthall: Which guideth unto righteousness, so we believe in it and we ascribe no partner unto our Lord.
translations.khattab: It leads to Right Guidance so we believed in it, and we will never associate anyone with our Lord ˹in worship˺
translations.arberry: guiding to rectitude. We believe in it, and we will not associate with our Lord anyone.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةࣰ وَلَا وَلَدࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
translations.pickthall: And (we believe) that He - exalted be the glory of our Lord! - hath taken neither wife nor son,
translations.khattab: ˹Now, we believe that˺ our Lord—Exalted is His Majesty—has neither taken a mate nor offspring
translations.arberry: He -- exalted be our Lord's majesty! has not taken to Himself either consort or a son.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدۡرِيٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ أَرَادَ بِهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ رَشَدࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.
translations.pickthall: And we know not whether harm is boded unto all who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intendeth guidance for them.
translations.khattab: Now, we have no clue whether evil is intended for those on earth, or their Lord intends for them what is right
translations.arberry: And so we know not whether evil is intended for those in the earth, or whether their Lord intends for them rectitude.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعۡنَا ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ فَمَن يُؤۡمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخۡسࣰ ا وَلَا رَهَقࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.
translations.pickthall: And when we heard the guidance, we believed therein, and whoso believeth in his Lord, he feareth neither loss nor oppression.
translations.khattab: When we heard the guidance ˹of the Quran˺, we ˹readily˺ believed in it. For whoever believes in their Lord will have no fear of being denied ˹a reward˺ or wronged
translations.arberry: When we heard the guidance, we believed in it; and whosoever believes in his Lord, he shall fear neither paltriness nor vileness.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لِّنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيهِۚ وَمَن يُعۡرِضۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسۡلُكۡهُ عَذَابࣰ ا صَعَدࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.
translations.pickthall: That We may test them thereby, and whoso turneth away from the remembrance of his Lord; He will thrust him into ever-growing torment.
translations.khattab: as a test for them. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of their Lord will be admitted by Him into an overwhelming punishment
translations.arberry: that We might try them therein. And whosoever turns away from the Remembrance of his Lord, He will thrust him into chastisement rigorous.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَدۡعُواْ رَبِّي وَلَآ أُشۡرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."
translations.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I pray unto Allah only, and ascribe unto Him no partner.
translations.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I call only upon my Lord, associating none with Him ˹in worship˺.”
translations.arberry: Say: 'I call only upon my Lord, and I do not associate with Him anyone.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: قُلۡ إِنۡ أَدۡرِيٓ أَقَرِيبࣱ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمۡ يَجۡعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّيٓ أَمَدًا

translations.saheeh: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."
translations.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): I know not whether that which ye are promised is nigh, or if my Lord hath set a distant term for it.
translations.khattab: Say, “I do not know if what you are promised is near or my Lord has set a distant time for it
translations.arberry: Say: 'I do not know whether that which you are promised is nigh, or whether my Lord will appoint for it a space;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لِّيَعۡلَمَ أَن قَدۡ أَبۡلَغُواْ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ وَأَحۡصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عَدَدَۢا

translations.saheeh: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
translations.pickthall: That He may know that they have indeed conveyed the messages of their Lord. He surroundeth all their doings, and He keepeth count of all things.
translations.khattab: to ensure that the messengers fully deliver the messages of their Lord—though He ˹already˺ knows all about them, and keeps account of everything.”
translations.arberry: that He may know they have delivered the Messages of their Lord; and He encompasses all that is with them, and He has numbered everything in numbers.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلۡ إِلَيۡهِ تَبۡتِيلࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
translations.pickthall: So remember the name of thy Lord and devote thyself with a complete devotion -
translations.khattab: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord, and devote yourself to Him wholeheartedly
translations.arberry: And remember the Name of thy Lord, and devote thyself unto Him very devoutly.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ۞إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعۡلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدۡنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَيِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَنِصۡفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةࣱ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحۡصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرۡضَىٰ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضۡرِبُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَبۡتَغُونَ مِن فَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنۡهُۚ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقۡرِضُواْ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنࣰ اۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُواْ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنۡ خَيۡرࣲ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيۡرࣰ ا وَأَعۡظَمَ أَجۡرࣰ اۚ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ ٱللَّهَۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمُۢ

translations.saheeh: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
translations.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord knoweth how thou keepest vigil sometimes nearly two-thirds of the night, or (sometimes) half or a third thereof, as do a party of those with thee. Allah measureth the night and the day. He knoweth that ye count it not, and turneth unto you in mercy. Recite, then, of the Qur'an that which is easy for you. He knoweth that there are sick folk among you, while others travel in the land in search of Allah's bounty, and others (still) are fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite of it that which is easy (for you), and establish worship and pay the poor-due, and (so) lend unto Allah a goodly loan. Whatsoever good ye send before you for your souls, ye will find it with Allah, better and greater in the recompense. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
translations.khattab: Surely your Lord knows that you ˹O Prophet˺ stand ˹in prayer˺ for nearly two-thirds of the night, or ˹sometimes˺ half of it, or a third, as do some of those with you. Allah ˹alone˺ keeps a ˹precise˺ measure of the day and night. He knows that you ˹believers˺ are unable to endure this, and has turned to you in mercy. So recite ˹in prayer˺ whatever you can from the Quran. He knows that some of you will be sick, some will be travelling throughout the land seeking Allah’s bounty, and some fighting in the cause of Allah. So recite whatever you can from it. And ˹continue to˺ perform ˹regular˺ prayers, pay alms-tax, and lend to Allah a good loan. Whatever good you send forth for yourselves, you will find it with Allah far better and more rewarding. And seek Allah’s forgiveness. Surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful
translations.arberry: Thy Lord knows that thou keepest vigil nearly two-thirds of the night, or a half of it, or a third of it, and a party of those with thee; and God determines the night and the day. He knows that you will not number it, and He has turned towards you. Therefore recite of the Koran so much as is feasible. He knows that some of you are sick, and others journeying in the land, seeking the bounty of God, and others fighting in the way of God. So recite of it so much as is feasible. And perform the prayer, and pay the alms, and lend to God a good loan. Whatever good you shall forward to your souls' account, you shall find it with God as better, and mightier a wage. And ask God's forgiveness; God is All-forgiving, All-compassionate.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةࣰۖ وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا عِدَّتَهُمۡ إِلَّا فِتۡنَةࣰ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِيَسۡتَيۡقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَيَزۡدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنࣰ ا وَلَا يَرۡتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضࣱ وَٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلࣰ اۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِي مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَمَا يَعۡلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَمَا هِيَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرَىٰ لِلۡبَشَرِ

translations.saheeh: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is hypocrisy and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allah intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allah leave astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And mention of the Fire is not but a reminder to humanity.
translations.pickthall: We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and their number have We made to be a stumbling-block for those who disbelieve; that those to whom the Scripture hath been given may have certainty, and that believers may increase in faith; and that those to whom the Scripture hath been given and believers may not doubt; and that those in whose hearts there is disease, and disbelievers, may say: What meaneth Allah by this similitude? Thus Allah sendeth astray whom He will, and whom He will He guideth. None knoweth the hosts of thy Lord save Him. This is naught else than a Reminder unto mortals.
translations.khattab: We have appointed only ˹stern˺ angels as wardens of the Fire. And We have made their number only as a test for the disbelievers, so that the People of the Book will be certain, and the believers will increase in faith, and neither the People of the Book nor the believers will have any doubts, and so that those ˹hypocrites˺ with sickness in their hearts and the disbelievers will argue, “What does Allah mean by such a number?” In this way Allah leaves whoever He wills to stray and guides whoever He wills. And none knows the forces of your Lord except He. And this ˹description of Hell˺ is only a reminder to humanity
translations.arberry: We have appointed only angels to be masters of the Fire, and their number We have appointed only as a trial for the unbelievers, that those who were given the Book may have certainty, and that those who believe may increase in belief, and that those who were given the Book and those who believe may not be in-doubt, and that those in whose hearts there is sickness, and the unbelievers, may say, 'What did God intend by this as a similitude?' So God leads astray whomsoever He will, and He guides whomsoever He will; and none knows the hosts of thy Lord but He. And it is naught but a Reminder to mortals.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ بَطۡشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ

translations.saheeh: Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe.
translations.pickthall: Lo! the punishment of thy Lord is stern.
translations.khattab: Indeed, the ˹crushing˺ grip of your Lord is severe
translations.arberry: Surely thy Lord's assault is terrible.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: سَبِّحِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡأَعۡلَى

translations.saheeh: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
translations.pickthall: Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High,
translations.khattab: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High
translations.arberry: Magnify the Name of thy Lord the Most High

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَذَكَرَ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ

translations.saheeh: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
translations.pickthall: And remembereth the name of his Lord, so prayeth,
translations.khattab: remember the Name of their Lord, and pray
translations.arberry: and mentions the Name of his Lord, and prays.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ

translations.saheeh: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with 'Aad -
translations.pickthall: Dost thou not consider how thy Lord dealt with (the tribe of) A'ad,
translations.khattab: Did you not see how your Lord dealt with ’Ȃd—
translations.arberry: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord did with Ad,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَصَبَّ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّكَ سَوۡطَ عَذَابٍ

translations.saheeh: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.
translations.pickthall: Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment.
translations.khattab: So your Lord unleashed on them a scourge of punishment
translations.arberry: Thy Lord unloosed on them a scourge of chastisement;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلۡمِرۡصَادِ

translations.saheeh: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.
translations.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful.
translations.khattab: ˹For˺ your Lord is truly vigilant
translations.arberry: surely thy Lord is ever on the watch.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكۡرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَكۡرَمَنِ

translations.saheeh: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
translations.pickthall: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me.
translations.khattab: Now, whenever a human being is tested by their Lord through ˹His˺ generosity and blessings, they boast, “My Lord has ˹deservedly˺ honoured me!”
translations.arberry: As for man, whenever his Lord tries him, and honours him, and blesses him, then he says, 'My Lord has honoured me.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكۡرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَكۡرَمَنِ

translations.saheeh: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
translations.pickthall: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me.
translations.khattab: Now, whenever a human being is tested by their Lord through ˹His˺ generosity and blessings, they boast, “My Lord has ˹deservedly˺ honoured me!”
translations.arberry: As for man, whenever his Lord tries him, and honours him, and blesses him, then he says, 'My Lord has honoured me.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَهَٰنَنِ

translations.saheeh: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."
translations.pickthall: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me.
translations.khattab: But when He tests them by limiting their provision, they protest, “My Lord has ˹undeservedly˺ humiliated me!”
translations.arberry: But when he tries him and stints for him his provision, then he says, 'My Lord has despised me.'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلۡمَلَكُ صَفࣰّ ا صَفࣰّ ا

translations.saheeh: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,
translations.pickthall: And thy Lord shall come with angels, rank on rank,
translations.khattab: and your Lord comes ˹to judge˺ with angels, rank upon rank
translations.arberry: and thy Lord comes, and the angels rank on rank,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱرۡجِعِيٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةࣰ مَّرۡضِيَّةࣰ‏

translations.saheeh: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],
translations.pickthall: Return unto thy Lord, content in His good pleasure!
translations.khattab: Return to your Lord, well pleased ˹with Him˺ and well pleasing ˹to Him˺
translations.arberry: return unto thy Lord, well-pleased, well-pleasing!

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسَوَّىٰهَا

translations.saheeh: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
translations.pickthall: But they denied him, and they hamstrung her, so Allah doomed them for their sin and rased (their dwellings).
translations.khattab: Still they defied him and slaughtered her. So their Lord crushed them for their crime, levelling all to the ground
translations.arberry: But they cried him lies, and hamstrung her, so their Lord crushed them for their sin, and leveled them:

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِلَّا ٱبۡتِغَآءَ وَجۡهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ

translations.saheeh: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.
translations.pickthall: Except as seeking (to fulfil) the purpose of his Lord Most High.
translations.khattab: but seeking the pleasure of their Lord, the Most High
translations.arberry: only seeking the Face of his Lord the Most High;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ

translations.saheeh: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
translations.pickthall: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee,
translations.khattab: Your Lord ˹O Prophet˺ has not abandoned you, nor has He become hateful ˹of you˺
translations.arberry: Thy Lord has neither forsaken thee nor hates thee

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَلَسَوۡفَ يُعۡطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرۡضَىٰٓ

translations.saheeh: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
translations.pickthall: And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content.
translations.khattab: And ˹surely˺ your Lord will give so much to you that you will be pleased
translations.arberry: Thy Lord shall give thee, and thou shalt be satisfied.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَأَمَّا بِنِعۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثۡ

translations.saheeh: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
translations.pickthall: Therefor of the bounty of thy Lord be thy discourse.
translations.khattab: And proclaim the blessings of your Lord
translations.arberry: and as for thy Lord's blessing, declare it.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرۡغَب

translations.saheeh: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
translations.pickthall: And strive to please thy Lord.
translations.khattab: turning to your Lord ˹alone˺ with hope
translations.arberry: and let thy Lord be thy Quest.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱقۡرَأۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ

translations.saheeh: Recite in the name of your Lord who created -
translations.pickthall: Read: In the name of thy Lord Who createth,
translations.khattab: Read, ˹O Prophet,˺ in the Name of your Lord Who created—
translations.arberry: Recite: In the Name of thy Lord who created,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱقۡرَأۡ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلۡأَكۡرَمُ

translations.saheeh: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -
translations.pickthall: Read: And thy Lord is the Most Bounteous,
translations.khattab: Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous
translations.arberry: Recite: And thy Lord is the Most Generous,

translations.pickthall: Lo! unto thy Lord is the return.
translations.khattab: ˹But˺ surely to your Lord is the return ˹of all˺
translations.arberry: Surely unto thy Lord is the Returning.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
translations.pickthall: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees.
translations.khattab: That night the angels and the ˹holy˺ spirit descend, by the permission of their Lord, for every ˹decreed˺ matter
translations.arberry: in it the angels and the Spirit descend, by the leave of their Lord, upon every command.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: جَزَآؤُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّٰتُ عَدۡنࣲ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدࣰ اۖ رَّضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَرَضُواْ عَنۡهُۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنۡ خَشِيَ رَبَّهُۥ

translations.saheeh: Their reward with Allah will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.
translations.pickthall: Their reward is with their Lord: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they dwell for ever. Allah hath pleasure in them and they have pleasure in Him. This is (in store) for him who feareth his Lord.
translations.khattab: Their reward with their Lord will be Gardens of Eternity, under which rivers flow, to stay there for ever and ever. Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him. This is ˹only˺ for those in awe of their Lord
translations.arberry: their recompense is with their Lord-Gardens of Eden, underneath which rivers flow, therein dwelling for ever and ever. God is well-pleased with them, and they are well-pleased with Him; that is for him who fears his Lord.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: جَزَآؤُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّٰتُ عَدۡنࣲ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدࣰ اۖ رَّضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَرَضُواْ عَنۡهُۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنۡ خَشِيَ رَبَّهُۥ

translations.saheeh: Their reward with Allah will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.
translations.pickthall: Their reward is with their Lord: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they dwell for ever. Allah hath pleasure in them and they have pleasure in Him. This is (in store) for him who feareth his Lord.
translations.khattab: Their reward with their Lord will be Gardens of Eternity, under which rivers flow, to stay there for ever and ever. Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him. This is ˹only˺ for those in awe of their Lord

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوۡحَىٰ لَهَا

translations.saheeh: Because your Lord has commanded it.
translations.pickthall: Because thy Lord inspireth her.
translations.khattab: having been inspired by your Lord ˹to do so˺
translations.arberry: for that her Lord has inspired her.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودࣱ‏

translations.saheeh: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
translations.pickthall: Lo! man is an ingrate unto his Lord
translations.khattab: Surely humankind is ungrateful to their Lord—
translations.arberry: Surely Man is ungrateful to his Lord,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لَّخَبِيرُۢ

translations.saheeh: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
translations.pickthall: On that day will their Lord be perfectly informed concerning them.
translations.khattab: surely their Lord is All-Aware of them on that Day
translations.arberry: surely on that day their Lord shall be aware of them!

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡفِيلِ

translations.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant?
translations.khattab: Have you not seen ˹O Prophet˺ how your Lord dealt with the Army of the Elephant
translations.arberry: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord did with the Men of the Elephant?

translations.pickthall: So let them worship the Lord of this House,
translations.khattab: let them worship the Lord of this ˹Sacred˺ House
translations.arberry: So let them serve the Lord of this House

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنۡحَرۡ

translations.pickthall: So pray unto thy Lord, and sacrifice.
translations.khattab: So pray and sacrifice to your Lord ˹alone˺
translations.arberry: so pray unto thy Lord and sacrifice.

translations.arberry: then proclaim the praise of thy Lord, and seek His forgiveness; for He turns again unto men.

translations.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak
translations.arberry: Say: 'I take refuge with the Lord of the Daybreak

translations.pickthall: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
